name: Pumpkin, red/yellow
storage: Whole: room temperature, away from sunlight, for 1–2 months. Cut: scoop out the seeds, wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 4–5 days. Peeled cubes freeze for about 3 months (for cooking only). Bottle gourd: fridge, 5–7 days whole; use cut pieces within 2 days.
looksLike: A large, round-to-flattened gourd with a mottled green-to-orange skin and thick, bright orange-yellow flesh. Usually sold as a cut wedge or slice because whole ones weigh several kilograms. "Disco" pumpkin is a smaller, round, yellow type.
shelfLife: Whole: 1–2 months in a cool, dry place. Cut: 4–5 days in the fridge.

usedIn.raw: 30 g (about 5–6 small cubes), pumpkin or bottle gourd
